title: Prompt-Counterfactual Explanations for Generative AI System Behavior

bias_targets.methodology: Generating news articles from headline prompts using LLMs and evaluating the political leaning of the generated text using a downstream classifier (PoliticalBiasBERT). The study applies a prompt-counterfactual explanation (PCE) algorithm to iteratively mask words in the prompt to identify which specific input terms trigger the model to generate politically biased (e.g., right-leaning) outputs.
